text:
nina: Heads-up: starting a cross-region handoff for routing-fallback-v2. We'll flip feature flag routing-fallback-v2-ff in us-west first, then stagger eu/apac. Change window 4h. Release notes: https://go/release/2026-03-routing-fallback-v2 :eyes:

deploy-bot: Canary cr-9009 created. t0 -> 1% in us-west (us-west-2). Dash: https://dash/redwood/canary/cr-9009

omar: Rollout constraints: holdpoints at 5% and 30%. Kill-switch if p95 > baseline + 130ms OR 5xx >0.35% sustained 5m. Also watch token throughput and auth latencies.

kevin: Prepared rollback artifacts: v1-pin tag=v1-pin-2026-03-22. Runbook with pinned commands: `/ff set routing-fallback-v2-ff 0%` and `/route-pin set default router v1 --tag v1-pin-2026-03-22`

nina: Plan I'm applying (region-by-region stagger):
```
feature_flag: routing-fallback-v2-ff
rollout:
  - t0: 1%
  - t+10m: 5%  # hold 20m
  - t+45m: 30% # hold 30m
  - manual: 100% per region
slo_triggers:
  p95_latency_ms: 130
  error_rate_pct: 0.35
  token_throughput_pct: 35
```

oncall-maya: Oncall here. I'll spin up a watch channel and the synthetic suite. Ping me immediately if any kill-switch criteria hit.

deploy-bot: t+12m metrics: p50 +7ms, p95 +22ms, 5xx within baseline. Advancing to 5% in us-west.

omar: small tail lift on one AZ (us-west-2b). If it's >15m I'll request an AZ override instead of global rollback. Keep the AZ pin command ready: `/route override --az us-west-2b --service router --pin v1 --tag v1-pin-2026-03-22`

kevin: Also pre-warmed caches and increased connection pools for v2 in us-west.

ops-bot: Observed increased token throughput on a subset of shards (us-west-2c) coincident with canary. Suggest watch 10m, then local pin if persists.

nina: Do the AZ pin if it persists. Do not pause the roll unless triggers hit. Keep manual approval for 100%.

kevin: If rollback needed the full command sequence in runbook is:
```
/ff set routing-fallback-v2-ff 0%
route-pin set default router v1 --tag v1-pin-2026-03-22
# confirm traffic drained then revert configs
```

deploy-bot: At t+50m: metrics stable at 30% holdpoint. p95 +28ms, 5xx nominal. Holdpoint timer started (30m).

oncall-maya: Synthetics report: core flows OK, auth latency +12ms. No pages. I'll keep a 30m active watch.

omar: Noticed one retry storm tied to an upstream rate-limit at t+60m. Mitigated with a transient throttling config fix; errors resolved. No rollback.

nina: Given mitigation and stable metrics, approve final push in 15m if no regressions. Reminder: no other infra deploys in change window.

deploy-bot: t+95m hold elapsed, ready for manual approval to 100% in us-west.

nina: Approved. Pushing to 100% in us-west now. `/ff roll routing-fallback-v2-ff --region us-west --target 100`

deploy-bot: Flag at 100% in us-west. Canary cr-9009 closed (success). Scheduling staggered rollouts: eu in 40m, apac in 80m following same holdpoints.

ops-bot: Please annotate the runbook with the AZ override example and keep v1-pin for 72h.

kevin: Will do. Also adding a short note about connection pool tuning we did.

doc-bot: Release notes updated: https://go/release/2026-03-routing-fallback-v2#done. Auto-generating post-deploy checklist doc and linking in calendar.

oncall-maya: I'll keep the watch for 2h post-roll. Ping me for immediate rollback.

nina: Great work everyone. Postmortem only if delayed regressions appear. Closing thread; follow-ups tracked in the release doc.
